title: Bind curated media and conference assets
method: Re-ran CV against t2 scraped LI images; kept t3 local winners where LI frames were graphic/chrome/blur; wired JOURNEY_MEDIA + PAST_CONFERENCES in RequestDemo.tsx

S1_Pain.rationale: No authentic logistics-pain photo; card-pain remains demoted as aspirational HQ glamour. LI scrape yielded no non-glamour industry-dialogue frame for pain.

S2_Talent.alt_de: Dicht besetzte TEG-Konferenz: Publikum mit Namensschildern, reservierte Plätze und Bühnenprogramm
S2_Talent.rationale: Densest real reserved-seat conference floor; beats stock card-benefit and informal LI fireside/enterprise frames for curated talent density.

S3_Host.alt_de: TEG Industry Panel im smartvillage: Gastgeber-Branding, Corporate-Entrepreneurship-Banner und gemischtes Publikum unter Kronleuchtern
S3_Host.rationale: Pure photographic Location-Host proof (smartvillage+ roll-up, TEG Corporate Entrepreneurship banner, live panel).

li_rejected.why: LinkedIn recap collage with heavy TEG branding chrome and multi-panel montage — not 1:1 LI UI, but designed social graphic; cooles-bild is cleaner pure photo of the same host model.

S4_Trust.alt_de: Historischer Zeitungsartikel: Elf Unternehmen gründen die Studentenvereinigung TEG e. V.
S4_Trust.rationale: Founding press proves 1986 institutional trust; card-why-teg empty hall remains demoted.

S5_Proof.rationale: Fact-led strip (ca. 125 / 1 Tag / 8.12.2026 München + organisers); no photo hero.

S6_AI_Consulting.alt_de: Plakat AI Consulting Conference 2026: 10. Juni 2026, Netlight Offices München, Gastgeber Netlight
S6_AI_Consulting.rationale: Only asset that names Gastgeber Netlight + date/venue for host-model graphic proof.

li_rejected.why: Video recap frame at registration desk is motion-blurred (551x310); no Netlight host identity visible — inferior to poster for gardens + host facts.

S6_Frontier_Tech.alt_de: Frontier Tech Conference 2025: volles Publikum und Vortrag in industriellem Veranstaltungsraum
S6_Frontier_Tech.rationale: Pure photographic Konferenz immersion (packed YPs, speaker, industrial hall, PushQuantum cue).

li_rejected.why: Official carousel recap graphics with arrows/chrome and multi-panel layout; larger PNG (~400KB) but less immersive than full-bleed hall photo.

size_check.largest_primary_note: hero-bg.jpg frozen; section heroes 84–150 KB — reasonable web weights
size_check.unused_li_note: Scraped LI PNGs kept under owned/ for attribution/reasoning only; not page primaries (no further compress required for ship)

linkedin_embeds: none — soft deep-links only on PAST_CONFERENCES
